meta.title: iCommerce
meta.description: Buy from Egyptian manufacturers: wholesale for companies, retail for everyone.

home.heroTitle: Made in Egypt. Bought by the piece or by the container.
home.heroBody: Furniture, carpets, cookware, textiles and building materials from Egyptian manufacturers. Buy retail with delivery, or source wholesale with MOQ, HS codes and quotes.
home.empty: No products are live yet. Check back soon.
home.sellBody: Egyptian manufacturers: list your products once and reach retail buyers and importing companies. Every supplier is verified.

login.sub: Sign in to track orders and check out faster.

cart.title: Your cart
cart.payNote: Pay cash on delivery or by bank transfer.
cart.emptyBody: Add products from any supplier. Each supplier ships its items separately, and you pay cash on delivery or by bank transfer.
cart.countLine: {items, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} from {vendors, plural, one {# supplier} other {# suppliers}} · each supplier ships separately
cart.subtotalN: Subtotal ({n, plural, one {# item} other {# items}})
cart.shippingN: Shipping, {n, plural, one {# supplier} other {# suppliers}}

product.decimalQuote: Sold in fractional quantities, which the cart can’t hold, so this product is quote-only.
product.rfqSoon: Quotes open for verified companies soon. Message the supplier from their store meanwhile.

category.count: {count, plural, =0 {No products} one {# product} other {# products}}
category.empty: No products in this category yet.

search.title: Search
search.count: {count, plural, =0 {No products found} one {# product found} other {# products found}}
search.emptyBody: Check the spelling, use fewer words, or search by HS code.

vendor.empty: This supplier has no live products yet.

register.sub: Create an account to track orders and save addresses.

errors.phone: Enter an Egyptian mobile number, e.g. 010 1234 5678.
errors.pickShipping: Choose a delivery option for this supplier.
errors.noShipping: A supplier in your cart doesn't deliver to this address yet. Remove their items or change the address.
errors.cartGone: Your cart is empty or was already ordered. Go back to the cart.
errors.placeFailed: The order couldn't be placed. Check each section and try again.
errors.badLogin: Email or password is wrong. Check both and try again.
errors.noAccount: No buyer account for this email yet. Create one below.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email exists. Sign in instead.
errors.fileTooBig: The file is over 10 MB. Upload a smaller photo or PDF.
errors.proofNotReady: Receipt upload isn't available for this order.
errors.proofFailed: Upload failed. Use a PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP under 10 MB.
errors.pickItems: Set a quantity for at least one item.
errors.returnNotReady: Return requests aren't available for this order yet.
errors.bankNeedsAccount: Sign in or create an account to pay by bank transfer, or choose cash on delivery.
errors.phoneIntl: Enter a phone number with country code, e.g. +20 2 1234 5678.
errors.kycFileRules: Use up to 10 PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP files, each under 10 MB.
errors.kycFailed: The documents couldn't be sent. Try again.
errors.notAllowed: Your role can't do this. Ask a company admin.
errors.qtyDecimal: Enter a quantity above 0, up to 3 decimals.
errors.price: Enter a price of 0 or more, e.g. 10.50.
errors.pickSupplier: Tick at least one supplier for this item.
errors.rfqEmpty: Your quote request has no items.
errors.netRefused: Net terms aren't available for this order. Choose another payment method.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.emailHelp: We send the order confirmation and tracking here.
checkout.vendorNoDelivery: This supplier doesn't deliver to your address yet.
checkout.pickupHelp: Collect from the supplier. They'll contact you.
checkout.freeOver: Free when your cart is {price} or more
checkout.noShipping: No delivery options for this address yet. Check the address, or remove items from suppliers that don't deliver there.

pay.codHelp: Pay each supplier's courier in cash when your items arrive.
pay.bankHelp: Transfer the total after ordering; we show the bank details and you upload the receipt. Suppliers ship once it's confirmed.
pay.netHelp: Order now and pay the invoice within {n} days. Available credit: {available}.
pay.net_limit: This order is over your available credit ({available}). Pay upfront or reduce the order.
pay.net_overdue: An invoice is overdue, so net terms are paused until it's paid.
pay.net_hold: Your credit account is on hold. Pay upfront meanwhile.

checkout.placeNote: You'll get a confirmation email. Each supplier ships its items separately.
checkout.bankAccount: Bank transfer needs an account so you can upload the receipt and follow the order. Your cart stays.

order.shipNote: Each supplier packs and ships its own items, so they may arrive on different days.
order.codHow: Have cash ready: each supplier's courier collects their part on delivery.
order.bankHow: Transfer {total} and write order #{n} as the reference. Suppliers ship once we confirm the transfer.
order.bankByEmail: Bank details are in your confirmation email.
order.proofHelp: PDF or photo (PNG, JPEG, WebP), up to 10 MB.
order.proofSent: Receipt uploaded. We'll confirm the transfer shortly.

return.requested: Return requested, waiting for the supplier.
return.approved: Return approved. Your refund is on its way.

order.returnHelp: For delivered items only. The supplier reviews your request; refunds follow approval.
order.returnSent: Return requested. The supplier will reply by email.
order.netHow: Invoiced to your company; pay by the due date.

account.title: My account
account.noOrdersBody: Orders you place while signed in show up here with tracking for each supplier.
account.addressNote: Checkout fills in your first saved address.

b2b.gate: Sign in as a company to see wholesale prices.
b2b.gateSignIn: Sign in or register your company
b2b.qtyQuote: Enter a quantity above 0 (up to 3 decimals).
b2b.quoteHelp: The supplier replies with unit price, lead time and offer validity.
b2b.rfqSub: Verified suppliers reply with unit prices, lead time and offer validity.
b2b.createBody: A company account gets wholesale prices, requests quotes from suppliers and can pay on net terms once verified. You become its admin and can invite colleagues.
b2b.invitedHint: Invited by a colleague? Open the link in your invitation email instead.
b2b.kycBody: Send your tax ID, commercial registration number and a scan of each document. We check them and email you the result.
b2b.kycUpdateNote: Sending new documents restarts the review; wholesale prices and quotes pause until we verify again.
b2b.kycFilesHelp: Tax card, commercial register, export card. PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 files of 10 MB each.
b2b.kycSent: Documents sent. We'll email you when the review is done.

kycHead.none: Verify your company to unlock wholesale

kycText.none: Wholesale prices, quotes and net terms open once your company is verified.
kycText.submitted: You'll get an email when the review is done. Until then you can browse and build quote requests.
kycText.verified: Your team sees wholesale prices, can request quotes, and can apply for net terms.
kycText.rejected: Fix what the note says and send the documents again.

b2b.kycAskAdmin: Ask a company admin to do this.
b2b.rolesExplained: Admins manage the company and members. Buyers request quotes and order. Approvers sign off quotes that buyers accept.
b2b.inviteSent: Invitation sent. The link is valid for 14 days.
b2b.joinBody: You're signed in as {email}. Accept to join the company that invited this address.
b2b.joinAlready: You already belong to {company}. An account can be in one company.
b2b.joinNoToken: This link is missing its invitation code. Open the link from the email again.
b2b.noSuggest: No supplier lists matching products yet. Reword the item, or request a quote from a product page.
b2b.rfqSubmitHelp: Each supplier gets its own quote request and replies separately.
b2b.rfqReviewBody: Check quantities, add a target price if you have one, then send. Suppliers reply with unit price, lead time and how long the offer is valid.
b2b.rfqNeedsVerify: Your company needs to be verified before you can send quote requests.
b2b.rfqNeedsCompany: Quote requests come from company accounts.
b2b.rfqEmptyBody: Add items with “Request quote” on a product page, or describe what you need here.
b2b.rfqSent: Quote request sent to {n, plural, one {# supplier} other {# suppliers}}.
b2b.approvalsBody: Buyers accepted these offers. Approve to place the order, or reject.
b2b.noQuotes: No quotes yet. Use “Request quote” on a product page or post a request on the home page.
b2b.acceptHelp: Accepting places the order at these prices.
b2b.acceptHelpBuyer: If your company uses approvers, the order waits for their approval.
b2b.waitingApproval: A buyer accepted this offer. It becomes an order once an approver or admin approves it.
b2b.counterHelp: Say what would make the deal work: price, quantity, lead time.
b2b.noCredit: Your company has no net-terms account yet. Our team sets one up on request; until then pay upfront.
b2b.noCreditUnverified: Net terms open to verified companies.
b2b.overdueBlock: An invoice is overdue. New orders on net terms are blocked until it's paid.
b2b.onHold: This credit account is on hold. Pay upfront meanwhile, or contact us.
b2b.creditHow: Orders on net terms are invoiced when placed; each invoice is due {n} days later.
